title: Chat bubbles in order, and the Refine page listens to the same mic

chat.text: Your jumbled statements: a bubble drawn late is now inserted by its time, not appended, and re-placed when its id changes; proven by a scripted four-sentence dictation whose screen order must equal the session file order. Then the Refine page takes its text from the chat session instead of its own mic, so phone, desktop and Refine give one result.
